summary: Iteration 73 - Finance Center (Xero) + Tickets Bulk Actions Testing Complete. Backend: 22/22 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified working correctly including Finance Center with 8 tabs, Tickets bulk selection/actions, and SLA countdown badges.

issues: Chart width/height -1 console warnings (cosmetic only, charts render correctly)

critical_code_review_comments: Finance Center (XeroDashboardPage) correctly implements 8 tabs: Overview, Invoices, Estimates, Recurring, Contacts, Accounts, Sync Log, Aging
Xero Dashboard API returns correct stats including aging buckets and collection_rate
Tickets page has bulk selection checkboxes with Select All functionality
Bulk actions bar appears with dropdown for Close, Assign, Priority, Status, Tag actions
SLA countdown badges display with color coding (red for overdue, amber for warning, green for OK)
Quick Template picker exists in ticket detail view next to Add Note button
Navigation consolidation: Finance Center appears under Business section with sub-items
seed_data_creation: Xero demo data auto-seeded on first access (invoices, contacts, estimates, recurring templates, sync history)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Finance Center and Tickets bulk actions fully tested. finance_center_loads.details: Finance Center loads at /xero with all 8 tabs visible

finance_center_invoices_tab.details: Invoices tab shows invoice list with search, status filter, Create Invoice button, Send/Pay/Void actions

finance_center_estimates_tab.details: Estimates tab shows estimates with search, Create Estimate button, Convert to Invoice action

finance_center_recurring_tab.details: Recurring tab shows templates with pause/resume toggle, Create Template button, MRR calculation ($5,010/mo)

finance_center_contacts_tab.details: Contacts tab shows Xero contacts with balance info

finance_center_accounts_tab.details: Accounts tab shows chart of accounts

finance_center_sync_log_tab.details: Sync Log tab shows sync history events with Trigger Sync button

finance_center_aging_tab.details: Aging tab shows aging buckets (Current $1,825, 1-30 Days $2,612.5, 31-60 Days $1,512.5, 90+ Days $0) and overdue invoices list

create_invoice_dialog.details: Create Invoice dialog opens with client name, reference, due date, line items with add/remove

create_estimate_dialog.details: Create Estimate dialog opens with title, client, valid until, notes, line items

create_recurring_dialog.details: Create Recurring dialog opens with client, description, frequency selector, line items

tickets_bulk_selection.details: Bulk selection checkboxes appear on each ticket card, 44 checkboxes found

tickets_select_all.details: Select All checkbox visible and functional (43 selected indicator shown)

tickets_bulk_actions_bar.details: Bulk actions bar appears when tickets selected with Apply button and action dropdown

tickets_sla_countdown.details: SLA countdown badges appear on ticket cards with color coding (red for overdue like -713h, amber for warning, green for OK)

tickets_quick_template_picker.details: Quick Template picker exists in ticket detail view next to Add Note button (data-testid='quick-template-picker')

navigation_finance_center.details: Finance Center appears under Business section in navigation with sub-items

backend_xero_dashboard_api.details: GET /api/xero/dashboard returns correct stats including aging, collection_rate, monthly_revenue

backend_xero_estimates_crud.details: GET/POST /api/xero/estimates works, POST /api/xero/estimates/{id}/convert converts to invoice

backend_xero_sync_history.details: GET /api/xero/sync-history returns events, POST /api/xero/sync triggers sync

backend_tickets_bulk_action.details: POST /api/tickets/bulk-action works for close, assign, priority, status, tag actions
